svg.title: the CI a generated project ships is valid — GitLab confirms the generated CI config is valid
svg.text: the CI a generated project ships is valid
Scenario: GitLab confirms the generated CI config is valid
The config every new project ships

g.text: Given a freshly generated project whose .gitlab-ci.yml wires in the
The .gitlab-ci.yml is the plan GitLab follows on every change. It pulls the whole DevSecOps
pipeline in from local include files. If a template change broke this file, every generated
project would ship a broken pipeline.
Then GitLab lints that config and reports it is valid
GitLab's pipeline editor reads the config the way it would before running it and shows a
green "Pipeline syntax is correct" when it holds together: no bad syntax, no missing
include. If a template change ever breaks the generated config, this verdict turns red.
